To calculate the average life ladder of countries in Asia in 2022 using SQL, you can use the following query:

```sql
SELECT AVG(ladder_score) as average_life_ladder
FROM global_life_ladder
WHERE country_region = 'Asia' AND year = 2022;
```

This query will return the average ladder score for all countries in Asia in the year 2022. The result will be presented with a clear label (`average_life_ladder`), making it easy to understand.
